title: Rook Checkmates
subtitle: The ladder, and king and rook

steps.say: Two rooks can checkmate on their own. It's called the ladder: they take turns checking, and the king climbs to the edge.
One rook guards a row, the other checks on the next one. Then they swap.

task.hint: One rook guards the 7th row. Use the other to check on the 8th.

steps.say: With one rook, your king has to help. First, use the rook to cut their king off.
Then walk your king up. When the kings stand face to face, check from the side, and their king has to step back.
Repeat until their king reaches the edge.

task.hint: Check along the edge. Your king covers the squares in front.
task.success: Checkmate with king and rook. That's a skill for life.

steps.say: Ladder with two rooks, king and rook with one. Practice both until they feel easy.
